NO PRIOR KNOWLEDGE IS REQUIRED. ONLY ETERNAL CURIOSITY AND THE PLEASURE OF KNOWLEDGE. PLS KEEP UPDATED of any changes and updates on our WhatsApp Group: [Enjoy Philosophy Lisbon Group Access-Link](https://chat.whatsapp.com/EgaLvlLCAbSL00cYmhpOSu) We will learn, debate, enjoy and investigate philosophers and diverse themes from the philosophical perspective. Each reunion is structured as a conversation among all attendees about that day s philosopher softly moderated by the organizer. The conversation will kick-off from the very brief suggested reading providing easy access to all attendees both to the philosopher and the conversation. Let´s be greek and dive today on… **KAIZEN... the Japanese wisdom of big transformations through small changes. Far from the the Paradigm of Disruptive Change as key to evolution so fundamental to Western Culture, the Japanese Kaizen wisdom believes in true transformation through small changes sustained along time. This shift in perspective produces an astonishing effect in western minds unveiling the real value of little actions, decisions, insights, so often unseen and unconsidered, so silenced under the noise of dramatic, spectacular change. Kaizen whispers that small decisions are big decisions. The unanswered call, the morning minimal gesture, the new road I take today for the first time going home, those... those indeed... are the big decisions of our lives. There is where the game is played. The epic signature of the divorce or the wedding, the plane taken to live in a new country, are only the final steps of a long series of small decisions and changes that started a long time before... settling over time and cristallizing eventually...** **So, lets think about Kaizen, the japanese wisdom of small changes....**

Hosted by business angel, author, and mentor Christoph Raethke (https://www.christophr.de), "Christoph's Feedback" is Berlin's only meetup where you will be positively challenged about founding a startup - or get actionable tips on how to get it financed. Too often, founders work on ideas that can never make it, no matter how passionate they are. Problems might be a twisted market, wrong perception of user needs, the fact that it has been tried x times before and always failed, and many other caveats that are best identified BEFORE starting to put serious effort into an idea. That's why "Christoph's Feedback" is a monthly event to either a) show and tell your startup or product idea in order to get tough feedback BEFORE you begin to seriously put work and money into it or start fundraising. The feedback you get might either be a strong suggestion to reconsider or even fold your idea - or highly valuable advice on the next most useful steps to turn it into reality. There's no need for you to prepare a slide deck or follow any "elevator pitch" rule; just tell us what you're working on or b) come as a guest to hear what other founders in Berlin are working on, learn how to discover critical challenges and questions about ideas yourself, and maybe even join the team of an idea you particularly like. The feedback you get will be powerful and meaningful, guaranteed.
